headline: Former BNP lawmaker Salahuddin Ahmed dies at Evercare Hospital
summary: The veteran politician served as an MP for the Dhaka-4 constituency across three different national elections.
details: Former BNP lawmaker Salahuddin Ahmed passed away while undergoing treatment at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka on Tuesday night at 8:10 PM.
A veteran in BNP politics, he was a highly influential leader in the Shyampura-Kadamtali area of the capital.
He was elected as a Member of Parliament for the Dhaka-4 seat in the 5th national election in 1991, the 6th election in February 1996, and the 8th national election in 2001.
Beyond his legislative role, he also served as the Trade Secretary of the BNP's central executive committee.
The Speaker of the National Parliament, Hafiz Uddin Ahmed Bir Bikram, Deputy Speaker Barrister Kaiser Kamal, and Chief Whip Nurul Islam Moni expressed deep grief over his death.
His funeral prayers (Janaza) will be held tomorrow, Wednesday, October 14, at 11:00 AM at the South Plaza of the National Parliament.
caption:
A veteran leader of the BNP and three-time MP for Dhaka-4 has passed away.

Former BNP lawmaker Salahuddin Ahmed passed away while undergoing treatment at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka on Tuesday night at 8:10 PM.

A veteran in BNP politics, he was a highly influential leader in the Shyampura-Kadamtali area of the capital.

He was elected as a Member of Parliament for the Dhaka-4 seat in the 5th national election in 1991, the 6th election in February 1996, and the 8th national election in 2001.

Beyond his legislative role, he also served as the Trade Secretary of the BNP's central executive committee.

The Speaker of the National Parliament, Hafiz Uddin Ahmed Bir Bikram, Deputy Speaker Barrister Kaiser Kamal, and Chief Whip Nurul Islam Moni expressed deep grief over his death.

His funeral prayers (Janaza) will be held tomorrow, Wednesday, October 14, at 11:00 AM at the South Plaza of the National Parliament.

headline_marked: 2 killed, 4 injured as [[under-construction roof collapses]] in Rangpur
headline: 2 killed, 4 injured as under-construction roof collapses in Rangpur
summary: The accident occurred at a municipal building site in Pirganj, leaving two workers dead and several others injured.
details: Two workers were killed and four others were injured when the roof of an under-construction municipal building collapsed in Pirganj, Rangpur.
The incident took place at the Pirganj Pourashava (municipality) building site, where workers were engaged in construction activities.
Following the collapse, rescue operations were launched to recover the victims from the debris.
The four injured workers were rescued and sent to the local hospital for medical treatment.
Local authorities and emergency responders arrived at the scene to manage the the situation and investigate the cause of the collapse.
caption:
Two workers killed and four others injured in a tragic roof collapse at a municipal building site in Rangpur.

Two workers were killed and four others were injured when the roof of an under-construction municipal building collapsed in Pirganj, Rangpur.

The incident took place at the Pirganj Pourashava (municipality) building site, where workers were engaged in construction activities.

Following the collapse, rescue operations were launched to recover the victims from the debris.

The four injured workers were rescued and sent to the local hospital for medical treatment.

Local authorities and emergency responders arrived at the scene to manage the the situation and investigate the cause of the collapse.
